Your request to correct the cost center for invoices has been processed. The invoices have been rebooked to the correct cost center (**CC-317**). Additionally, your refund of **45** for the rebooking fee has been issued and should be reflected in your account within 2–3 business days.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
